feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Poland with a ridge to France, while low pressure covers the mid-Atlantic. New high expected near Cornwall by Saturday afternoon, 1030 hPa.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4. Backing south or south-southwest tomorrow afternoon, still mainly 3 or 4 but occasionally 5 in the North Channel and then in central parts of the area later on Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling generally slight overnight, then occasionally moderate in central parts of the area later on Saturday.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches, with occasional rain this evening & tonight, becoming mainly fair by dawn on Saturday but still a few areas of mist near some coasts.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in mist, very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or south-southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing mainly 3 or 4 but still occasionally 5 in the North Channel until Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but a risk of mist or fog patches in places.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, becoming poor in any mist & very poor in any fog patches.
